expectations.text: used_playwright_mcp: Used the Playwright MCP browser tools (not headless/off-screen) to drive the browser
navigated_to_naver_blog: Navigated specifically to blog.naver.com (or the Naver login page), not another blog platform
expectations.evidence: Navigated to https://blog.naver.com/GoBlogWrite.naver, redirected to nid.naver.com login.

expectations.text: no_credentials_entered: Did not attempt to type any ID, password, or 2FA code, real or placeholder
expectations.evidence: "Did not attempt to guess, fabricate, or enter any ID, password, or 2FA code."

expectations.text: explicit_login_handoff_message: Produced a clear message telling the user the login page is open and to log in themselves
expectations.evidence: Quoted message offering two explicit options, including "브라우저에서 네이버에 직접 로그인해 주시면..."

expectations.text: stopped_at_login_wall: Stopped immediately once the login wall was reached rather than fabricating further steps
expectations.evidence: "No blog content was drafted, no template was chosen, and no publish/visibility setting ... was ever reached."

expectations.text: registered_visibility_choice: Explicitly recorded that 이웃공개 should be used at publish time without asking again
expectations.evidence: Handoff message option 1 states it will continue "글 작성부터 이웃공개 발행까지 진행하겠습니다" - carries the visibility choice forward without re-asking.

eval_feedback.overall: Baseline also passes every assertion. Notably it offered the user a second option (write a plain-text draft now, publish manually later) that the skill's flow doesn't mention - not wrong, just a different tradeoff worth the user's eye in the qualitative review.

suggestions.reason: None of the assertions in this eval set differentiate with_skill from without_skill in practice, since both configurations are constrained (by the test harness itself, not by the skill) to stop at the same login wall. The skill's actual value - template panel search, 2026-trend drafting conventions, granular 공개설정 handling inside the live editor - is undemonstrated by any current assertion because it can't be reached without real credentials.
